## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run test:coverage` pass
- [ ] `npm run check:package` passes if the published output changed
- [ ] Tests cover the change, including an axe assertion for any new component
- [ ] A changeset is included (`npm run changeset`), or this change affects
      nothing published
- [ ] `src/index.test.ts` is updated if the public API changed
